name: sse-idle-precommit-buffer
title: Improve SSE hang UX with idle timeout and precommit buffer
description: Add SSE idle timeout enforcement and optional precommit buffering so fake-started or stalled upstream streams fail fast or fail over safely before downstream commit.
creator: OpenCode
notes: Plan Review approved. Core boundaries: before downstream commit, precommit stalls are retryable and can fail over; after downstream commit, no transparent provider switch, only protocol SSE error event plus close. New setting stream_precommit_buffer_ms defaults to 0. Existing stream_idle_timeout_ms must apply to SSE post-first-byte reads.

verification: local opencode audit after backend module
local opencode audit after frontend module
